'''Tim Stack''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Birmingham Grand Slam]] on 28 October 2000 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|old-school There Is Good In Him]], according to Steven Lewis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1463">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-17-mr-2nd-place-and-the-birmingham-slamd1463/ mr-2nd-place-and-the-birmingham-slam], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 17 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-17-mr-2nd-place-and-the-birmingham-slamd1463/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
